description: This file defines the AgentRegistry class responsible for managing a list of agents, including registration, deregistration, loading from configuration or database, and database CRUD operations related to agents within a larger AI or agent management system.

classes.name: AgentRegistry
classes.description: A class that manages agent instances, including their registration, deregistration, retrieval, and database operations.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the agent registry with an empty agent list.

methods.name: reset_agent_list(self)
methods.description: Resets the internal agent list to an empty list.

methods.name: register_agent(self, agent_config: AgentResponse)
methods.description: Adds a new agent to the internal list.

methods.name: deregister_agent(self, agent_name: str)
methods.description: Removes agents from the list matching the given agent name.

methods.name: get_agent_list(self, agent_names: Optional[List[str]] = None)
methods.description: Returns a list of agents, optionally filtered by agent names.

methods.name: List[AgentResponse] get_public_agent_list(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of agents that are in public agent groups, based on external litellm configuration.

methods.name: str _create_agent_id(self, agent_config: AgentConfig)
methods.description: Creates a unique agent ID by hashing the agent configuration.

methods.name: load_agents_from_config(self, agent_config: Optional[List[AgentConfig]] = None)
methods.description: Loads agents from a provided configuration list.

methods.name: load_agents_from_db_and_config( self, agent_config: Optional[List[AgentConfig]] = None, db_agents: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None, )
methods.description: Loads agents from configuration and database sources, replacing the current list.

methods.name: AgentResponse add_agent_to_db( self, agent: AgentConfig, prisma_client: PrismaClient, created_by: str )
methods.description: Asynchronously adds an agent to the database.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] delete_agent_from_db( self, agent_id: str, prisma_client: PrismaClient )
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an agent from the database by ID.

methods.name: AgentResponse patch_agent_in_db( self, agent_id: str, agent: PatchAgentRequest, prisma_client: PrismaClient, updated_by: str, )
methods.description: Asynchronously patches an existing agent's data in the database.

methods.name: AgentResponse update_agent_in_db( self, agent_id: str, agent: AgentConfig, prisma_client: PrismaClient, updated_by: str, )
methods.description: Asynchronously updates an agent's data in the database.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_all_agents_from_db( prisma_client: PrismaClient, )
methods.description: Retrieves all agents from the database asynchronously.

methods.name: Optional[AgentResponse] get_agent_by_id( self, agent_id: str, )
methods.description: Retrieves an agent by its ID from the internal list.

methods.name: Optional[AgentResponse] get_agent_by_name(self, agent_name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an agent by its name from the internal list.
